subject: german
topicDisplay: Area B Personal And Social Life
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: How do you say 'My throat hurts'?
questions.explain: 'Halsschmerzen' = 'a sore throat'; 'Kopf' = head and 'Bauch' = stomach are the distractors.

questions.q: How do you say 'We give each other presents at Christmas'?
options: Wir schenken uns Geschenke zu Weihnachten
Wir schenken uns nichts zu Weihnachten
Wir bekommen keine Geschenke zu Weihnachten
Wir kaufen uns Geschenke zu Ostern
questions.explain: 'Schenken' = 'to give (as a gift)' and 'zu Weihnachten' = 'at Christmas'.
'Die Nachrichten' means 'the news' (TV/radio); singular 'eine Nachricht' = a message.
'Der Brauch' means 'a custom/tradition'; don't confuse with 'brauchen' = to need.
'Malen' means 'to paint'; don't confuse with 'mahlen' (to grind).

questions.q: Which sentence means 'My parents are divorced'?
questions.explain: 'Geschieden' = 'divorced'; 'verheiratet' (married) and 'verlobt' (engaged) are near-miss distractors.
'Das Schlagzeug' means 'the drum kit' (from 'schlagen' = to hit).
'Der Adventskranz' means 'the Advent wreath'; 'der Adventskalender' is the calendar.
False friend: 'die Note' is a school 'grade/mark' (e.g. 'eine gute Note'), not an English 'note'.
'Das Tor' means 'the goal' (also 'gate'); 'ein Tor schießen' = 'to score a goal'.
'Eine Sendung' is a TV/radio programme (from 'senden', to broadcast).
'Großzügig' means 'generous'; it does not literally mean 'big' despite containing 'groß'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Ich verbringe zu viel Geld online
Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit online
questions.explain: 'Zeit verbringen' = 'to spend time' and 'zu viel' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.

questions.q: How do you say 'My best friend is reliable'?
questions.explain: 'Zuverlässig' = 'reliable' and 'mein bester Freund' = 'my best friend'.
'Suchen' = 'to look for/hunt', so 'Ostereier suchen' = 'to hunt for Easter eggs'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I do exercise to stay fit'?
options: Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu bleiben
Ich treibe Sport, um müde zu werden
Ich esse Pommes, um fit zu bleiben
Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu sein
questions.explain: 'Sport treiben' = 'to do sport/exercise' and 'um fit zu bleiben' = 'in order to stay fit'.
'Die sozialen Medien' means 'social media' (also 'soziale Netzwerke' = social networks).

questions.q: How do you say 'In my free time I often play chess'?
options: In meiner Arbeit spiele ich oft Schach
In meiner Freizeit höre ich oft Musik
In meiner Freizeit spiele ich oft Schach
In meiner Freizeit spiele ich nie Schach
questions.explain: 'Die Freizeit' = 'free time/leisure' and 'Schach spielen' = 'to play chess'.
'Die Beziehung' means 'the relationship'.
'Die Suchmaschine' means 'the search engine' (suchen = to search + Maschine).
'Der Heiligabend' is 'Christmas Eve' (24 December); 'Silvester' is New Year's Eve.
'Die Werbung' means 'advertising/adverts'.
